commit: add pie chart layout to language card

truth.description: The donut strokes each arc with the raw color the top languages fetcher copies from GitHub, which is null for a language GitHub gives no color, so that arc renders with stroke null and no visible color while its legend dot falls back to gray.

distractions.why: The donut's svg is as tall as it is wide, so taking the vertical center from the width puts it at the same point as the horizontal one.
